# Swan River Inputs {#swan-river}

## Overview



## River contribution to Cockburn Sound

River tracers used within CSIEM have been analysed to understand the river mass flux into (and out of) the CS region. This shows the seasonal pulse of material entering the Sound during winter conditions, and this is highly variable depending on the river flow magnitude in any given year (Figure 7.18).
